name: jei-integration-table
description: JEI Integration Table category, opened from the table's energy-bar click area. JEI ignores the bridge's key injection (it listens to NeoForge's key event), so lookups go through mouse clicks.

steps.label: setup
run: item replace entity @p hotbar.2 with buildcraftunofficial:robot

steps.name: table-gui
steps.look: the real Integration Table GUI, for comparing its ring/preview/result layout with the JEI page

steps.label: click the energy bar (JEI click area)

steps.name: jei-category
steps.look: JEI page titled Integration Table: blank robot in the centre of the 3x3 ring, a programmed board in the top-left ring cell, the programmed robot in the preview and result slots, MJ cost under the panel; crop clean (no title text, no inventory)

steps.label: left-click the result robot = its recipes

steps.name: jei-robot-recipe
steps.look: the programmed robot's recipe lookup lands on the Integration Table entry for that program (1/1, or 1/N if crafting recipes also show), not 'no recipes'

steps.label: right-click the centre blank robot = its uses

steps.name: jei-blank-robot-uses
steps.look: uses of the blank robot include the Integration Table category paging through every robot program
